newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-SRI LANKA WINS TOSS, BAT AGAINST PAKISTAN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SRI LANKA WINS TOSS, BAT AGAINST PAKISTAN.

text.p: Sri Lanka won the toss and decided to bat against Pakistan in the second and final test match in Colombo on Saturday.

Sri Lanka - Arjuna Ranatunga (Captain), Sanath Jayasuriya, Russel Arnold, Marvan Atapattu, Aravinda de Silva, Hashan Tillekeratne, Romesh Kaluwitharana, Chaminda Vaas, Ruwan Kalpagae, Sajeeva de Silva, Jayantha Silva
Pakistan - Ramiz Raja (Captain), Salim Ilahi, Izaj Ahmed, Salim Malik, Inzamam-ul-Haq, Asif Mujtaba, Moin Khan, Saqlain Mushtaq, Mustaq Ahmed, Mohammed Zahid, Shahid Nazir.
